text: Bitcoin is treading water near $65k while Ethereum has gone slightly negative, suggesting cautious positioning rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 31 indicates genuine apprehension, though the 7-day uptick hints at some stabilization from deeper lows. Bitcoin's dominance holding above 56% paired with modest $32B daily volume points to a market waiting for clearer signals rather than capitulating or rallying hard.
